purpose: Select a shared reward-blind warm start by extending the exact factorized marginal-shaping objective to the horizon required by the unchanged support and power gate.

v3_terminal_record.accepted_disposition: V3 remains terminal and is never resumed or retried.
v3_terminal_record.v4_legitimacy: V3 established that the corrected objective moves both marginals in the intended direction but its frozen 16-step horizon ended before either reached the unchanged joint envelope. V4 is a distinct, fresh-seed horizon-extension design; it does not relax or replace any observed threshold.

design_analysis.reason: The inherited target policy produced exactly 4.170366 expected informative groups and the v3 final policy produced 4.938245, both below the unchanged 5.5 floor. A root-only run could pass only through uncontrolled collateral target drift.
design_analysis.selected_design: Continue the same exact route-by-digit product supervision long enough for both marginals to enter the already-frozen joint envelope.

factorized_dataset.policy: Reuse the byte-identical reward-blind factorized corpus. The defect was its renderer, not its labels or factorization.

initialization.selection_training_model: Merge the inherited adapter into the named base in BF16, then train one new LoRA against that exact deployed initialization.
initialization.v3_checkpoints_are_not_initialization: V4 starts from the same inherited Stage C2 adapter, not from any observed v3 checkpoint.

sft.unchanged_from_v3: Corpus, renderer, batch shape, optimizer, learning rate, scheduler, LoRA shape, no-shuffle policy, initialization, and number of retained adapter checkpoints.
sft.checkpoint_efficiency: Even-step checkpoints retain 16 adapters across twice the optimizer horizon, matching v3's checkpoint count and avoiding unnecessary remote and local storage.
sft.one_run_rule: After the first optimizer step, do not rerun SFT, change the corpus, change hyperparameters, or train replacement candidates.

candidate_selection.rule: Select the earliest ascending optimizer checkpoint satisfying every frozen check; later checkpoints are not consulted.
candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate: Record a terminal Stage C4 selection failure, run no RL campaign, recover compact artifacts, and do not retry this selection.

authoritative_scoring.model_form: BF16 merged model, never runtime-LoRA scores
authoritative_scoring.engine: Pinned vLLM installation and the campaign model-loading mode
authoritative_scoring.parallelization: Action and root scorers are independent and run concurrently on separate GPUs; their signed payloads and decision logic are unchanged.

separation.campaign_freeze_condition: A selected adapter hash, merged-model manifest, exact support report, and terminal selection record must be local before any credit-confusion RL call.

renderer_alignment_gate.position: after inherited-model merge and before the first v4 SFT optimizer step
renderer_alignment_gate.failure_handling: Any mismatch terminally closes v4 before optimization.

scorer_lifecycle.implementation: The unchanged signed hard-exit supervisor validated in v2 and v3.
scorer_lifecycle.v3_live_evidence: 32 candidate scorers exited zero with parent-verified signatures.
scorer_lifecycle.v4_policy: Every candidate scorer still uses the signed supervisor; no redundant pre-SFT model-scoring gate is run.

pre_model_call_checks: Verify every frozen source and data hash.
Run all root tests and affected Prime/taskset tests.
Parse the SFT configuration through Prime-RL SFTConfig.
Verify the expected external Prime patch reverse-applies.
Run the frozen v4 preregistration audit.
execution.failure_handling: After any optimizer step, any failure is terminal for v4. Recover all compact artifacts and do not retry.
execution.local_artifact_policy: Keep exact scores, signed verifications, manifests, logs, reports, and only a selected adapter. Compress terminal evidence and do not sync intermediate adapters, merged 4B models, optimizer states, or CUDA caches.
execution.remote_cleanup: Remove every rejected merged candidate before scoring the next and destroy all unretained checkpoints at teardown.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.availability_observed: At freeze, Prime reported zero eligible non-spot 2x48GB resources. No pod or disk exists.
hardware.selection_reason: Wait for the cheapest genuinely available eligible resource instead of spending on A100/H100 or changing the hardware envelope.
hardware.resource_pin_rule: Before provisioning, commit a hardware-only amendment naming the exact eligible resource ID, provider, location, and rate.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.
